wacc.formula: WACC = wₑ × kₑ + w_d × k_d × (1 − t);  kₑ = r_f + β × ERP
steps: β (Blume-adjusted) = 0.67 × raw β 0.66 + 0.33 = 0.77  (104 weekly returns vs SPY, R² 0.05)
k_d = 7.10%  (10-year Treasury + 2% (no rate on file)); after tax 7.10% × (1 − 29%) = 5.04%

methods.formula: FCFF = EBIT × (1 − t) + D&A − capex − ΔWC;  EV = Σ FCFF/(1+WACC)^t + TV/(1+WACC)^5;  TV = NOPAT₆ × (1 − g ÷ ROIC) ÷ (WACC − g);  value = (EV − debt + cash − claims) ÷ shares
steps: growth by year 5%, 5%, 4%, 4%, 3%; EBIT margin 23.5%; D&A 7.6% of revenue; capex 21.5%, 19.7%, 18.0%, 16.2%, 14.5% of revenue; ΔWC 10% of each revenue increase
